review_context.method: The reviewer read the pinned original clauses and canonical premises before examining all nine scoped catalogues, their generated regions, 86 original executions and both generators. Actual input bytes, column fields, reconstructed statement lengths and fingerprints were checked independently. Compiler evidence was consulted after source reasoning; no compiler was run or fixture approved by the reviewer.
review_context.integration: The coordinator implemented the source-span and narrowly input-bound reporting changes requested by review. The source-defensible missing-successor pair was then authored and executed. This receipt distinguishes those later changes from the original draft review.

6.3.2.3.rationale: Character-context exceptions, three comment-line classes, placement and semantic inertness are distinct. The 319-record control preserves empty and all-blank records and tests the initialized sentinel before overwriting it.

6.3.2.4.rationale: Inter-token, split-token and character continuations retain their separate premises, marker rules, significant blanks and comment behavior. Reporting spans and the qualified GNU warning implement RP1/RP2. The new complete-END EOF pair closes only the noncharacter missing-successor facet; the character-context counterpart remains pending.

6.3.2.5.rationale: The not-continued premise, semicolon contexts, terminator elision, permitted successors and separator-run equivalence are accounted for without importing fixed-form restrictions.

6.3.2.6.rationale: Whole-statement label permission includes the valid free-form semicolon successor. The million-character assignments have independently measured source lengths, selected integer arithmetic and a demonstrated-capacity executing control; the over-limit oracle requires a statement-length report.

6.3.3.1.rationale: Exactly 72 logical default-kind source characters are distinguished from raw file records and the nondefault-kind branch. The 71/73-byte and nondefault-kind reporting facets require independent input-mapping evidence, not a fabricated universal padding/truncation rule.

6.3.3.2.rationale: Commentary precedence, character-context exclusions and the sixth-position exception are preserved. C/c, asterisk, exclamation positions, blank records and placement have defined independent oracles, without assumptions about arbitrary extra characters.

6.3.3.3.rationale: Source-justified precision preserves S6.3.3.3-001 and both existing facet meanings. Initial/continuation fields, comment precedence, literal padding, token splitting, intervening comments and a true orphan are separate. The original calibration bytes remain unchanged but its expanded requirement legitimately changes its review fingerprint.

6.3.3.4.rationale: The leading-semicolon negatives isolate initial-line restrictions with otherwise blank label/continuation fields. Character data, comments and sixth-position semicolons retain different roles.

6.3.3.5.rationale: All seven sentences and program-unit membership are accounted for. Label placement, exact statement size, actual-END versus apparent-END restrictions and the nonunit exclusion are distinct. END reports are confined to their two-line statements and cannot be substituted by ancestor-file failures.

reporting_repairs.repair: Declare source.f90:5-6, preserving legitimate first-line and successor-line reports. An explicitly declared span requires full containment of the reported point/range; whole-program recovery ranges do not pass.
reporting_repairs.actual_result: Both formerly misclassified GNU rejections now satisfy the reviewed contract.

reporting_repairs.repair: Qualify the exact f951 warning text and parsed line through one hash-verified ASCII free-form Fortran input, one compilation step and no INCLUDE spelling. Competing source locations disqualify the attribution; the raw output is not rewritten to invent a filename.
reporting_repairs.actual_result: GNU's real zero-exit warning is now reported as diagnosis with explicit single-source driver attribution.

reporting_repairs.repair: The six fixed program-unit END negatives declare their exact two-line spans. Both million-plus-one negatives declare the reconstructed statement span and require statement-length-specific messages; numeric limit text alone is not sufficient.
reporting_repairs.exclusions: Wrong steps/files, unrelated statements, whole-program recovery ranges, input/module/option failures, source echoes, resource failures, compiler crashes and timeouts are not substitute evidence.

missing_successor_pair.source_basis: 6.3.2.4 p2: a terminal marker requires a later noncomment line. All other program tokens, including END PROGRAM p, are complete.
missing_successor_pair.edit_proof: The control deletes exactly one ampersand and retains the trailing blank and all LF records.
missing_successor_pair.diagnostic_binding: The source-specific predicate is confined to line 2 through the observed one-past-final-record position 4. Position 4 is an EOF coordinate, not an invented fourth physical record. The oracle does not accept an arbitrary unlocated scan/parse summary.

observations.lfortran: Reports unexpected EOF at position 4; passes.
observations.flang: Reports the invalid terminal ampersand at line 2; passes.
observations.gfortran: Emits an inconsistent-internal-state warning and then an internal compiler error/segmentation fault; remains failure, never corroboration.
observations.repair: All three compile the one-edit control successfully.

preservation_and_measurements.source_comparison: Compared each source with its exact author-commit blob, not with regenerated expectations.
preservation_and_measurements.changed_prior_fingerprint: Only S6_3_3_3_001_valid__verbatim, because its source requirement was legitimately expanded.
preservation_and_measurements.measurement_method: Reconstructed free statement text after excluding markers, comments and terminator; reconstructed fixed statement fields in columns 7-72 excluding the comment record and terminator. Both payloads and lengths are independently checked. Fixed records remain exactly 72 bytes; free physical lines remain within the separate limit.
preservation_and_measurements.generator_checks: Both generators support compare-only verification. Integration changes generated diagnostic metadata, not the reviewed Fortran payloads.
preservation_and_measurements.persistent_guards: Corpus regressions reconstruct both million-character pairs and verify the exact EOF repair/coordinate, alongside the existing physical-line boundary checks.

source_only_cases.S6_3_2_4_002_invalid__ampersand_comment: The only nonblank source before commentary is an ampersand, forbidden by 6.3.2.4 p1. All selected compilations return zero without a report. A one-exclamation repair converts that physical line to commentary without changing surrounding code.
source_only_cases.S6_3_2_6_002_invalid__1000001: The independently reconstructed free statement has 1000001 source characters, with no earlier line-limit or malformed-token defect. Its adjacent control executes successfully. All selected compilers are silent; retain the source-based statement-length reporting oracle.
source_only_cases.S6_3_3_5_002_invalid__length_1000001: The independently reconstructed fixed statement exceeds the one-million-character limit while preserving every 72-character line. The adjacent compile-only control is admitted. All selected compilers are silent; no wrong-location or resource explanation substitutes for reporting.
source_only_cases.S6_3_3_5_004_invalid__apparent_end_bare: The initial END appearance is prohibited for this continued statement even though the complete assignment is otherwise legal. All selected compilers accept silently; the split-after-EN control repairs precisely that appearance.
source_only_cases.S6_3_3_5_004_invalid__apparent_end_space: Fixed-form blank insignificance makes E N D the same initial END appearance. Removing the blanks does not repair the restriction; moving the split after EN does. Universal selected-mode acceptance does not replace the source oracle.

pending_oracles.S6.3.2.4-005:missing-later-line-diagnost: A truncated character continuation also lacks its literal delimiter and enclosing unit. Generic missing-END/EOF reporting cannot independently establish the missing-successor condition. A discriminating continuation-specific oracle remains unestablished; the new noncharacter EOF pair does not close this facet.
pending_oracles.S6.3.3.1-001:short-source-line-report: A raw 71-byte record is expressible, but an independently qualified interface must retain a genuinely 71-character logical source line instead of padding it.
pending_oracles.S6.3.3.1-001:overlong-source-line-report: A raw 73-byte record is expressible, but the interface must retain its last character as source instead of ignoring an external sequence field. A permissive-width option is not the required premise.
pending_oracles.S6.3.3.1-001:nondefault-character-limit: A supported nondefault source repertoire, encoding-to-character mapping and processor maximum need independent evidence. UTF-8 bytes, tabs, literal kind prefixes or the currency exception do not establish them.
